redFirst.basis: `python3 tools/check-browser-install.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 on "NameError: name '_bash_version' is not defined" (read as python), and the task introduces '_bash_version': absent from HEAD's tools/gate-parity.py, .github/actions/browser-install/action.yml, CONTRIBUTING.md, tools/check-browser-install.py and present in the working tree's tools/check-browser-install.py; a second run with the working tree's implementation copied in exited 0 without that error, its tests reaching their assertions; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop; deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: tools/check-browser-install.py: every rule now asks one place, `_bash_reading(parts)`, for a word's value after quote removal (None when an expansion or an unquoted character bash expands makes it unknowable), the sole expansion the word is, and whether it can split; `_word` reads a word into bash's parts (dq backslash removal included) and the spelling-only `quoted` key is gone; command word, set, printf (value known, not starting with '-'), eval (exactly one double-quoted $( ) calling apt-config, nothing beside), [ (known operator, unsplittable operands) and redirection targets (/dev/null by value, >& 1/2 by value, $GITHUB_OUTPUT as the sole expansion) read only that. Third escape found and closed: a builtin called before a same-named function definition (no function may take a stub, tool or builtin name). `{name}` against a redirection refused (bash 4.1+ per the manual). New cases: bq1 (920 respellings of refused shapes), bq2 (324 respellings of the action's shapes), bq3 (each shape and its respellings run under bash's xtrace against the stubs: started commands on the vocabulary, same commands and exit as bare), bq4-bq7 (the three escapes, past the reader and as a step). Construction rows now name their hold lines and rerun with them removed, which must reach outside; this answers finding P169-R105: bk11 was seen red on bash 5.2.21 in CI run 44684189710 (K4, both lines removed), and on bash 5 the unset line and the read-only line each hold it alone (44684182939, 44684186240); on bash 3.2 there is no command hash array and bk11's label says so. Docstring restated (stays-outside list, reading-alone list, versions named; bk1/bk2/bk7 are held by both lines each alone on bash 3.2 but only by the disabling line on bash 5.2.21). BUILTINS reasons rewritten as families. CONTRIBUTING.md: one sentence. Mutation probe scratchpad/p169-29/mutations.py: run 2 saved file says 19 row(s), 0 not as expected (spelling-direction rows turn bq1/bq2 red, over-fire rows turn sd8/bp11 red). Full sweep 198/198 files ok, 19746 cases. Check CPU user+sys interleaved: head 6.22/6.51, final 6.53/6.63.
outcome.descriptive: The browser install check's reader judges each word by the value bash hands on, so a quoted option, text beside eval's substitution, or a function shadowing a builtin can no longer pass, and a case fails by name if a rule reads spelling again.

bq2: each shape the action has is read with no problem under every respelling
